excluded_labels.waist: Missing for 87 speakers; numeric values include adult waists of 30–40 despite the documented centimetre unit. Do not silently convert suspected inches or train on ambiguous units.

protocol.nisp: Official train/test identities; model selection uses training speakers and cohort-disjoint validation folds. Previously inspected Malayalam test speakers are reported separately and excluded from the fresh-test promotion decision.
protocol.calibration: Reserve 20 percent of official training identities for prediction intervals before any fitting or feature selection.
protocol.crema: Deterministic 60/20/20 speaker-disjoint fit/calibration/test split, stratified by broad age brackets. Neutral speech only; no emotion or protected-attribute prediction.
protocol.candidates: Standardized Ridge and RBF support-vector regression; compare legacy pitch/spectral features with formant and resonance descriptors. Evaluate an independently trained age-only encoder if available.
protocol.controls: Constant training median, recording nuisance features, frozen deployed height model, and aggregate confound audit using provided metadata only.
protocol.gate: Training cross-validation MAE improves at least 10 percent over the constant baseline; fresh-test paired bootstrap improvement lower 95 percent bound is positive; controlled perturbations do not increase MAE by more than 20 percent. Passing this research gate does not establish ambient or population-wide validity.
protocol.test_use: Freeze feature definitions and hyperparameter grid before scoring fresh test speakers. Do not retune to test results.
protocol.uncertainty: Split-conformal absolute-residual intervals at nominal 90 percent coverage; report actual test coverage and width. These are marginal intervals under exchangeability, not per-person guarantees.
protocol.replacement: The expanded height head must pass the gate and have a positive lower 95 percent paired-bootstrap improvement bound against the frozen deployed height head. Otherwise retain its coefficients and calibrate intervals using only non-Malayalam calibration speakers.

age_encoder_protocol.output: age only; all other output branches removed before any inference
age_encoder_protocol.limitation: Source model training identities unavailable; possible actor overlap with VoxCeleb pretraining cannot be ruled out.
